summary: Sun Life Financial Inc. filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report on Form 8-K) disclosing the appointment of Darko Mihelic as Senior Vice-President, Head of Investor Relations, effective October 22, 2026, succeeding Natalie Brady, who moved to a capital management role. The filing contains a news release only, with no transaction, stake, price, premium or board recommendation. This is a routine executive appointment rather than an abrupt or forced CEO/CFO/board departure, so it is not classified as a special situation. No deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
